name: book-buddy

dependencies.name: library-service
dependencies.description: Looks up books by genre/author and checks a specific book's availability, via searchBooks and getBook only.

description: Conversational agent that helps a Team Member discover books in the team library — recommending titles by genre or author and reporting whether a specific book is currently available. Its tool allow-list is limited to library-service's searchBooks and getBook operations, so it can never mention a book that isn't really in the catalogue and never changes any book's state. Reached through the standard /chat interface via the Try It test app; there is no web application in this project.
